scope: Exact finite algebra; no circuit synthesis or full DQI execution
lower_bound_scope: r fixed as separate control; each phase term is r*l(H)*m(Z); independent invertible linear changes within H and within Z. Rank 3 requires at least 3 such terms.
excluded_claims: arbitrary Clifford+T or adaptive circuit lower bound
impossibility of improved nonlinear fusion or S-box synthesis
